Business Analysis – Waterfall, Agile models Wealth Management & Insurance Digitalization SDLC – Business Documentation, Jira & Confluence tools

Career Obje ctiv e MBA professional and Senior Business Analyst with 6 years of experience in Wealth Management and Insurance domains, specializing in business process analysis, stakeholder management, data-driven insights, and regulatory compliance. Proven expertise in bridging business and technology to drive strategic initiatives, enhance operational efficiency, and improve customer experience. Seeking a challenging role to leverage my analytical skills, financial acumen, and problem-solving abilities to contribute to business growth and innovation in a dynamic organization. Professional Abstracts

Overall experience of 8 years out of which 6 yrs. in to Business Analyst role in Wealth Management & Insurance domain with a proven track record in delivering projects across SDLC methodologies - Agile and Waterfall.

A result-oriented MBA professional diverse roles distinguished by commended performance in Product management and Business Analysis in Wealth Management, Investment Advisory Services, Portfolio Management Services, Mutual Funds & Insurance Domain.

Worked in Insurance Digital transformation projects under multiple areas in Life Insurance policy sourcing, Origination, automation of underwriting processes, policy administration services etc. ● Practical knowledge on Insurance products, processes & regulatory compliance. Having good knowledge on Business Transformation portal & Life Asia applications. Gained expertise in policy administration services like policy endorsement, reinstatement, claim & surrender processes.

Knowledge on Software development life Cycle (SDLC) Stages, Coordinated with all technical Stakeholders like UI designers, Front end, Back-end Developers, Quality Analysts etc.

Good in collaborating with Quality Analyst in preparing test cases, reviewing test cases, Conducting UAT before sprint releases.

Good in Requirement Analysis, Business documentation, Stakeholder Management, Cross-functional coordination, Client handling & negotiation, conflict management.

Experienced in gathering business requirements, analyzing and preparing project deliverables such as User Stories, Business Requirement Document (BRD), Functional Requirement Document (FRD/Solution document), use cases, test cases, User manuals, Process flow diagrams.

Conducted Gap Analysis, Impact Analysis after requirement gathering to prepare documentation. ● Working experience in an Agile Scrum environment with ability to breakdown business requirements in to meaningful functionalities by writing user stories on Jira Tool.

Participated in Scrum events like Sprint planning, Review, retrospective, Status call & Backlog grooming.

Strong knowledge of Insurance products, regulatory frameworks, and industry best practices, enabling me to identify opportunities for process optimization and compliance enhancement.

Skilled in translating complex business needs into functional requirements, creating detailed documentation, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure successful project implementation.

Conducted various workshops, brainstorming sessions with Product Managers, Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), and Business Users to understand the requirements and specifications for new applications along with re - engineering the existing applications.

Good experience in handling senior business stakehol9ders, features prioritization, working as per the deadlines. Demonstrated new features to Management, various business teams, gathered feedback.

Core Competencies:

Business Analysis Skills Business Analysis Business Documentation & Demonstration Business Process Modelling diagrams

Wealth Management, Insurance Domain Skills Wealth Management products Life Insurance Products, Processes & Compliance Technology Enabled Business Transformation

Stakeholder Management, Cross functional Technical Awareness of the projects. Tools – Jira Tool, MS Visio, Confluence Good exposure to stakeholder handling

Investment Services Accounts (ISA) Insurance Digital Journeys – STP Journeys Policy Administration Services – STP Journeys

Policy claim & Settlement, Surrender processes

Collaboration and Facilitation Documentation – BRD, FRD, User Stories

Policy Sourcing KYC, AML (Digital & CRM Channels)

Policy endorsement, reinstatement

Professional Experience 1) Eclerx Services Ltd.- Sr. Business Analyst(Aug 2025 till Now)

Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, and cross-functional teams to gather, analyze, and document business and functional requirements for multiple strategic initiatives.

Worked on Data Migration projects, ensuring accurate mapping, validation, reconciliation, and smooth transition of data between legacy and target systems.

Contributed to Financial Planning projects by analyzing business processes, identifying gaps, and supporting implementation of process improvements and system enhancements.

Played a key role in Digital Transformation initiatives, including enhancements to an existing wealth management application to improve user experience, operational efficiency, and business workflows.

Conduct requirement elicitation sessions, workshops, and stakeholder discussions to define project scope, business rules, and acceptance criteria.

Prepare and maintain documentation such as BRDs, FRDs, user stories, process flows, gap analysis, and functional specifications.

Work closely with development, QA, and product teams throughout the SDLC to ensure successful delivery of business requirements.

Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog grooming, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives using Agile and Scrum methodologies.

Support UAT activities by coordinating testing efforts, validating business scenarios, and ensuring defect resolution aligns with business expectations.

Track project progress, manage stakeholder communication, and ensure timely delivery of project milestones.

Utilize tools such as Jira and Confluence for requirement management, sprint tracking, and project documentation.

Collaborate with technical and business teams to identify process optimization opportunities and recommend scalable business solutions.

2) Nuvama Wealth – Sr. Business Analyst (Jul 2024 to Jul 2025)

Sr. Business Analyst in Wealth Management Projects for feature Enhancements in areas like Mutual funds financial & Non-financial transactions in Investment Services Account (ISA). Implementation of onboarding platform for ISA A/c’s. Roles & Responsibilities:

Worked in Agile under scrum framework for Digital Transformation Project for enhancement of various features in Wealth Management Services platform.

Gathering the requirements & splitting them into User stories with defined acceptance criteria before starting to work with Technical Teams like Design, Development & Quality Analysis.

● Taking the ownership of Product Backlog, continuously grooming the backlog & prioritizing the

requirements in the backlog.

● Contributed in all scrum ceremonies like Sprint planning, Daily standup, Sprint review, Retrospective,

Backlog grooming Sessions.

Conducted meetings with technical team to give a walk through on requirements before implementation & Testing them.

Monitoring, reporting of ongoing, upcoming features, open issues to management on a timely basis. ● Handled bugs as part of production support as well along with delivery of the new features. ● Prioritized the requirements in backlog based on business demands, highest business value being added to the product.

Coordinated with UI Designer Teams for getting required prototype before Development initiation. ● Assisted QA teams in preparing Test Cases and participated in functional Testing along with QA. ● Coordinated with Project stakeholders throughout the project life cycle till functionality go live. ● Demonstrated the developed functionalities to Business teams through PPT presentations. ● Continuous Engagement with Business teams for taking new requirements & giving updates on ongoing work, upcoming releases, challenges, open issues etc.

Collaborated with Scrum master to review reports like burn up, burn down charts, velocity reports and discussed strategies to improve productivity.

2) Bajaj Capital Pvt Ltd – Business Analyst Duration: Jan 2019 to June 2024. Business Analyst for Different Wealth Management Projects in Investment Advisory Services, Mutual Funds Service Portal, Insurance Digital Journeys – Policy Origination, Administration Services (Servicing). Roles & Responsibilities

Stakeholder Management and Requirement gathering. Conducted AS-IS and TO-BE Analysis and suggest Fit for Business Solutions by designing a Change Strategy.

Organize & Lead Requirement Gathering (Elicitation) meetings using techniques like Interviews, Questionnaires, Document Analysis, Brainstorming Sessions and Focus Group Discussions

Evaluated change requests by impact analysis of triple constraints – time, cost, scope. ● preparing BRD, FRD, user stories, information architecture and demo story boards. ● Performing gap analysis between the developed features and the nuances in the industry. ● Elicitation Techniques, Effective Usage of Tools and Techniques, Maintaining Product Backlog and prioritizing features. Review test cases created by QA team & Conducting UAT.

Successfully participated in various Scrum Ceremonies by sharing opinions on process & product innovation. Product feature enhancements recommendations on quality.

3) ICICI Prudential Life Insurance Ltd-Sales Development Manager (Nov 2017 to Dec 2018)

Sale Development Manager – Sales Strategy and Forecasting, Client Relationship Management, CRM & Pipeline Management & Market research and Analysis. Roles & Responsibilities

Enhanced profitability by developing pipelines utilizing marketing and sales methods • Created and implemented new business opportunities by utilizing strategic networking strategies. • Communicate product quality and market comparisons by creating sales strategies. • Maintained up-to-date knowledge of competitor products and pricing in market served. • Built relationships with customers and community to establish long-term business growth. • Encouraged cross-selling of additional products and services through relationship-building and acquired understanding of customer business needs.

Previous Experience

Worked as Intern in H & R Block Pvt Ltd (Internship)during Feb-17 & Aug-17.

Technical Skills

Project Management Tools/Methodology Office Tools

Jira tool, Confluence for business documentation, Agile - Scrum Framework, Waterfall Model, MS Visio, Draw.io, Balsamiq for basic wireframing. MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint.

Self believe, Hardworking, Growth, Learning mindset, Patience, Optimistic. Following latest innovations in Wealth Management, Insurance & Technology Watching Business Case studies. English, Hindi, Marathi, Spanish (Level-1), Kanadda

Professional Experience 1) Eclerx Services Ltd.- Sr. Business Analyst(Aug 2025 till Now)
Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, and cross-functional teams to gather, analyze, and document business and functional requirements for multiple strategic initiatives.
Worked on Data Migration projects, ensuring accurate mapping, validation, reconciliation, and smooth transition of data between legacy and target systems.
Contributed to Financial Planning projects by analyzing business processes, identifying gaps, and supporting implementation of process improvements and system enhancements.
Played a key role in Digital Transformation initiatives, including enhancements to an existing wealth management application to improve user experience, operational efficiency, and business workflows.
Conduct requirement elicitation sessions, workshops, and stakeholder discussions to define project scope, business rules, and acceptance criteria.
Prepare and maintain documentation such as BRDs, FRDs, user stories, process flows, gap analysis, and functional specifications.
Work closely with development, QA, and product teams throughout the SDLC to ensure successful delivery of business requirements.
Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog grooming, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives using Agile and Scrum methodologies.
Support UAT activities by coordinating testing efforts, validating business scenarios, and ensuring defect resolution aligns with business expectations.
Track project progress, manage stakeholder communication, and ensure timely delivery of project milestones.
Utilize tools such as Jira and Confluence for requirement management, sprint tracking, and project documentation.
Collaborate with technical and business teams to identify process optimization opportunities and recommend scalable business solutions.
2) Nuvama Wealth – Sr. Business Analyst (Jul 2024 to Jul 2025)
Sr. Business Analyst in Wealth Management Projects for feature Enhancements in areas like Mutual funds financial & Non-financial transactions in Investment Services Account (ISA). Implementation of onboarding platform for ISA A/c’s. Roles & Responsibilities:
Worked in Agile under scrum framework for Digital Transformation Project for enhancement of various features in Wealth Management Services platform.
Gathering the requirements & splitting them into User stories with defined acceptance criteria before starting to work with Technical Teams like Design, Development & Quality Analysis.
● Taking the ownership of Product Backlog, continuously grooming the backlog & prioritizing the
requirements in the backlog.
● Contributed in all scrum ceremonies like Sprint planning, Daily standup, Sprint review, Retrospective,
Backlog grooming Sessions.
Conducted meetings with technical team to give a walk through on requirements before implementation & Testing them.
Monitoring, reporting of ongoing, upcoming features, open issues to management on a timely basis. ● Handled bugs as part of production support as well along with delivery of the new features. ● Prioritized the requirements in backlog based on business demands, highest business value being added to the product.
Coordinated with UI Designer Teams for getting required prototype before Development initiation. ● Assisted QA teams in preparing Test Cases and participated in functional Testing along with QA. ● Coordinated with Project stakeholders throughout the project life cycle till functionality go live. ● Demonstrated the developed functionalities to Business teams through PPT presentations. ● Continuous Engagement with Business teams for taking new requirements & giving updates on ongoing work, upcoming releases, challenges, open issues etc.
Collaborated with Scrum master to review reports like burn up, burn down charts, velocity reports and discussed strategies to improve productivity.
2) Bajaj Capital Pvt Ltd – Business Analyst Duration: Jan 2019 to June 2024. Business Analyst for Different Wealth Management Projects in Investment Advisory Services, Mutual Funds Service Portal, Insurance Digital Journeys – Policy Origination, Administration Services (Servicing). Roles & Responsibilities
Stakeholder Management and Requirement gathering. Conducted AS-IS and TO-BE Analysis and suggest Fit for Business Solutions by designing a Change Strategy.
Organize & Lead Requirement Gathering (Elicitation) meetings using techniques like Interviews, Questionnaires, Document Analysis, Brainstorming Sessions and Focus Group Discussions
Evaluated change requests by impact analysis of triple constraints – time, cost, scope. ● preparing BRD, FRD, user stories, information architecture and demo story boards. ● Performing gap analysis between the developed features and the nuances in the industry. ● Elicitation Techniques, Effective Usage of Tools and Techniques, Maintaining Product Backlog and prioritizing features. Review test cases created by QA team & Conducting UAT.
Successfully participated in various Scrum Ceremonies by sharing opinions on process & product innovation. Product feature enhancements recommendations on quality.
3) ICICI Prudential Life Insurance Ltd-Sales Development Manager (Nov 2017 to Dec 2018)
Sale Development Manager – Sales Strategy and Forecasting, Client Relationship Management, CRM & Pipeline Management & Market research and Analysis. Roles & Responsibilities
Enhanced profitability by developing pipelines utilizing marketing and sales methods • Created and implemented new business opportunities by utilizing strategic networking strategies. • Communicate product quality and market comparisons by creating sales strategies. • Maintained up-to-date knowledge of competitor products and pricing in market served. • Built relationships with customers and community to establish long-term business growth. • Encouraged cross-selling of additional products and services through relationship-building and acquired understanding of customer business needs.
Previous Experience
Worked as Intern in H & R Block Pvt Ltd (Internship)during Feb-17 & Aug-17.
